profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer- IT, Dell Technologies | USMC Veteran
profile.summary: Enthusiastic leader capable of handling and adapting to high stress scenarios. Striving to gain knowledge and experience in the software development, finance, and real estate sectors.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer IT
positions.description:
• Splunk Developer
	· Developed and implemented custom Splunk dashboards to improve system observability and data- 
          driven decision-making
	· Collaborated with technical and non-technical teams to define monitoring needs and streamline 
           incident response processes
	· Actively pursuing Splunk Enterprise Architect certification to deepen platform expertise and drive 
          scalable observability solutions across enterprise systems
• Jr Architect
	· Led internal architecture efforts using Sparx and Visio following C4 modeling concepts to support 
          strategic planning and system documentation for enterprise projects
	· Presented technical concepts to stakeholders and championed tools to improve operational 
           efficiency
• Automation
         · Delivered 76+ automation tasks, including VM provisioning, application upgrades, and confluence 
           documentation that enhanced delivery scalability
	· Presented architecture and automation proposals to Architecture Review Boards and Security Review 
          Boards, securing approvals and enabling production implementation
	· Onboarded new automation team members by facilitating knowledge transfer sessions, account 
          setup, and system access, accelerating ramp-up and team integration
• QA Manual E2E Testing
	· Conducted end-to-end functional testing for multiple platforms ensuring defect-free deployments
	· Internal Sales Apps, Oracle based apps, SalesForce apps, Power BI Reports, Database testing 
          (Cloudera, Greenplum, and Teradata)
	· Coordinated with cross-functional teams to resolve critical application outages under tight timelines, 
          supporting release testing and production deployments

positions.title: Youth Basketball Coach
positions.description:
-Developed weekly practice plans with a progressive structure: foundational drills that built upon each other, strategic team concepts, and coach led scrimmages to reinforce learning
-Led weekly practices and games emphasizing team communication, confidence building, and positive reinforcement
-Developed player rotation and game-time decisions to maximize development and learning outcomes
-Communicated weekly schedule updates to parents and athletes to ensure team-wide coordination
-Collaborated with Sports Director, Team Coaches, parents, and athletes  to resolve scheduling conflicts and confirm game/practice availability

positions.title: I MEF Ammuntion Chief’s Clerk
positions.locationName: Camp Pendleton South, California, United States
positions.description:
•Oversaw the explosive safety training of 233 individuals across 7 teams under I MEF and increased the certification status from 82% to 97%. 
•Reviewed and updated current Explosive Safety Order MCO 8023.3D to reflect the updates to compliances required by the Department of Defense. 
•Executed monthly site inspections to ensure compliance with Camp Pendleton Base Explosive Safety orders and formed corrective actions for any shortfalls.
•Complied historical data of ammunition usage for all units on Camp Pendleton to analyze and create following fiscal year allocation distribution.

positions.title: Records Section Team Leader
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
•Mastered the Ordnance Information System (OIS) and Total Ammunition Information System (TAMIS) to manage an inventory of 219-line items which consisted of 46,405,279 rounds of ammunition, totaling to a sum of $447,668,246. 
•Accurately processed an average of 80 ammunition request forms and maintained a balanced record of all inventories that were requested and/or returned.
•Completed quarterly audits of all inventory and corrected discrepancies, via research of inventory counts sheets, online inventory database (OIS), and archived documents. 
•Oversaw field planning and coordination in full compliance with established command structures and ensured a 100% delivery of all required inventory. 
•Supervised personnel and offered extensive mentoring and performed monthly counseling to ensure constant communication and growth.

positions.title: Ammuntion Technician
positions.locationName: Camp Pendleton South, California, United States
positions.description:
•Organized Storage locations according to hazard classification and compatibility.
•Performed routine inspection of storage sites, ensuring compliance of Marine Corps Base Order and Ammunition Supply Point SOP’s. 
•Processed ammunition request orders by conducting safe packaging and accurate counts to ensure 100% inventory accuracy of all in house stocks.

positions.title: Clerk
positions.description:
•Trained new associates on cash register operations including opening, 
conducting customer transactions and balancing drawer.
• Maintained an hourly cleaning schedule increasing productivity by 15%, 
adequately stocked and organized the sales floor according to the corporate 
floor plan and introduced new procedures to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Supervised end-to-end stock management, including examining incoming 
inventory, merchandising shelves and preventing shrinkage.
• Decreased inventory shrinkage, drive-off and daily cash discrepancies by closely 
monitoring daily operations.
